data.name: desktop.minimised
data.value: The program keeps running and keeps taking orders. You get it back from the taskbar.

data.name: desktop.quit.body
data.value: Phones can no longer place orders afterwards.

data.name: desktop.error.dataFolderRepair
data.value: Click "Repair the setup". Nothing can be written into the folder {path}. Windows asks you once while it happens.

data.name: desktop.error.noNetwork
data.value: Connect the laptop to the WiFi the phones are on. The laptop is not on any network at the moment.

data.name: desktop.error.startFailed
data.value: The server could not be started. Quit the program and start it again. If that does not help, click "Repair the setup".

data.name: desktop.settings.repairDeclined
data.value: In the Windows settings, open "Firewall & network protection" and allow this program the incoming connection on all networks. For the data folder you need somebody who can confirm the question Windows asks.

data.name: desktop.firstRun.body
data.value: Confirm the question Windows asks. The program allows access from the network and creates its data folder.

data.name: desktop.firstRun.declined
data.value: The program runs anyway. If the phones cannot reach the laptop later, click "Repair the setup".

data.name: desktop.firstRun.setupFailed
data.value: The setup could not be completed, although you confirmed the question Windows asked. The program runs anyway. If the phones cannot reach the laptop, or if orders cannot be saved, click "Repair the setup".

data.name: desktop.settings.repairFailed
data.value: The setup could not be completed, although you confirmed the question Windows asked. Click "Repair the setup" once more. If that does not help, click "Open the data folder" and give the newest file in the folder "logs" to somebody who knows this laptop.

data.name: desktop.settings.repairDone
data.value: The setup was repaired. Start the program again so the change takes effect.

data.name: desktop.notice.addressChanged
data.value: Everybody has to set their phone up again, because the server address has changed.

data.name: desktop.error.noPortAvailable
data.value: Another program on this laptop is blocking the connection. Restart the laptop and open the program again.

data.name: desktop.error.instanceCheckFailed
data.value: Look on the task bar for a window of this program. If there is none, restart the laptop and open the program again. The program could not check whether it is already running and has not started the server.

data.name: desktop.update.confirmBody
data.value: Version {version} is ready. A restart installs it now. Without a restart it installs itself when you next quit.
